To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the functional down‐regulation of 5‐HT presynaptic autoreceptors is involved in the increase in K+-stimulated 5-HT release in rat brain slices of animals chronically treated with lithium.
chronic lithium treatment is associated with an increase in K+ evoked release of 5‐HT from rat brain slices.
The effect of chronic lithium treatment on 5‐HT neurotransmission was investigated in superfused rat brain cortical, hippocampal and hypothalamic slices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of chronic lithium treatment on the regulation of 5‐HT neuronal activity in the rat brain.
the effect of lithium treatment on 5‐HT metabolism and release and on 5‐ HT autoreceptors in the brain of the rat.
the effects of chronic lithium treatment on 5‐HT function in rat brain slices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
chronic lithium treatment results in an increase in the sensitivity of 5‐HT receptors in the brain, but that it does not affect the release of the transmitter.
chronic lithium administration is associated with a decrease of 5‐HT presynaptic autoreceptors and an increase of 5‐ HT release.
lithium treatment results in a functional down regulation of 5‐HT presynaptic autoreceptors in the rat brain, which is accompanied by an increase in K+ stimulated 5‐HT efflux in brain slices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
chronic lithium administration increases the number of serotonin receptors in the brain.
chronic lithium treatment increases 5‐HT neurotransmission by reducing 5‐HT presynaptic autoreceptor activity and by increasing the number of 5‐HT receptors.

chronic lithium treatment results in a functional down regulation of presynaptic 2‐hydroxy‐5‐methyltryptamine (2‐OH‐5‐MTP) autoreceptors, resulting in a decrease in 5‐HT uptake and an increase in 5‐hydroxtryptamine release.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of chronic lithium treatment on 5‐HT function in the brain is not uniform and depends on the brain area examined.
the effect of lithium on 5‐HT neurons depends on the brain area and the experimental conditions.
the effects of chronic lithium on the serotonergic system are complex and depend on the brain area examined.
